recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up portrait of a young girl with pale skin and striking blue eyes, framed by wind-swept blonde hair. The lighting is dramatic, emerging from deep shadows, paired with elegant, centered gold and white typography that frames the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's eyes as the primary focal point centered horizontally
Wild, organic hair textures contrasting with rigid, geometric typography
Deep black negative space framing the face and supporting text legibility
Warm gold title treatment against cool, desaturated skin tones
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting with heavy shadows on the right side of the face
Desaturated, gritty skin texture with visible dirt or smudges
Centered vertical alignment for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face, occupying the central 70% of the frame, slightly offset to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's bright blue eyes, specifically the one on the left (viewer's perspective).
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the large gold title, then travels upward to the top header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders at the top and bottom edges provide a stage for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale, desaturated peach and cream (skin and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant cerulean blue (irises) and metallic gold (title)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin and background; low saturation except for the eyes and gold text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and metallic accents

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a high-contrast serif with sharp, flared terminals
Secondary text uses a clean, all-caps sans-serif with extreme tracking
Title features a metallic 3D gradient effect with inner glows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'M' in the title has a deep, sharp V-shape
Lowercase 's' has a slightly elongated, elegant curve

composition.overlap: Slightly over the subject's chest area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the brand/title paired with a minimalist sans-serif for informational metadata.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines with diamond-shaped accents flanking the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: For the main title's classical, dramatic serif feel.
For the clean, geometric headers with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, high-contrast portrait of a young girl with messy blonde hair and intense blue eyes. The lighting should be dramatic chiaroscuro, with one side of the face in deep shadow. The skin should look slightly dirty and desaturated. The background is solid black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in a gold-beveled serif font in the lower third. Above it, add a block of cast names in a small, white sans-serif. At the very top, add two lines of wide-tracked, all-caps sans-serif text. Add thin decorative lines at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the gold text beveled and metallic?
Is the tracking on the top text extremely wide?
Are the eyes the sharpest part of the image?
Is the right side of the face lost in shadow?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue in the eyes
Amount of hair strands crossing the face
Brightness of the gold metallic effect
Tracking width of the secondary text

avoid: Cartoonish or overly saturated skin tones

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic hair texture and strands
Ensure the gold gradient doesn't look like flat yellow
Verify the text is perfectly centered
Confirm the background is a true, deep black
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, desaturated character portrait with centered, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif headers and a large, beveled metallic serif title for a cinematic period-drama aesthetic.
